summary: Python framework để xây dựng, trực quan hóa và quản lý các hệ thống multi-agent được cấp bởi LLM với hỗ trợ real-time, voice và multimodal.
usecases: Developing collaborative multi-agent workflows for automated research or report generation
Building voice-enabled AI assistants with real-time agent reasoning and response
Creating modular LLM agent pipelines for enterprise automation tasks like customer support triage
ideas: Combine agentscope with a knowledge base to build an autonomous AI research assistant that iteratively queries sources and synthesizes findings
Deploy agentscope agents as edge computing workers for on-device AI personalization without cloud dependency
Use agentscope's multi-modal capabilities to build a unified assistant processing text, voice, and images simultaneously for accessibility tools
